---
title: "Regional Ecosystem Service Hotspot Profile"
subtitle: "`r params$report_title`"
author: "Global NCP Analysis"
date: last-modified
date-format: "YYYY-MM-DD"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    code-fold: true
    embed-resources: true
    theme: cosmo
params:
  # Exactly one of these should be set; the others may be NULL.
  # For cross-cuts (e.g. region + income), set both — requires raw grid data
  # via the optional plt_long_path parameter.
  grouping_var: "region_wb"           # "region_wb" | "income_grp" | "WWF_biome" | "nev_name"
  group_val:    "Sub-Saharan Africa"  # exact value as it appears in hotspot_area_stats.csv
  report_title: "Sub-Saharan Africa"
  # Optional: path to raw long-format grid parquet/gpkg for cross-cut filtering.
  # Leave NULL to use pre-computed CSVs only.
  plt_long_path: NULL
execute:
  cache: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(scales)

devtools::load_all(quiet = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(
  list.files(here::here("R"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE),
  source
))
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| include: false

subsets_root <- file.path(data_dir(), "processed", "tables", "regional_subsets")
gv           <- params$grouping_var
grp          <- params$group_val

safe_name <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+", "_", x)
  gsub("^_|_$", "", x)
}

# --- hotspot_area_stats for this group ----------------------------------------
area_path <- file.path(subsets_root, gv, paste0("hotspot_area_stats_", safe_name(grp), ".csv"))
if (!file.exists(area_path)) {
  # Fallback: filter the combined grouping-var CSV
  combined_path <- file.path(subsets_root, gv, paste0("hotspot_area_stats_", gv, ".csv"))
  if (file.exists(combined_path)) {
    area_df <- read_csv(combined_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
      filter(group == grp)
  } else {
    # Last resort: full table
    area_df <- read_csv(
      file.path(data_dir(), "processed", "tables", "hotspot_area_stats.csv"),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ) |> filter(grouping_var == gv, group == grp)
  }
} else {
  area_df <- read_csv(area_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
}

# --- hotspot_multiservice_stats -----------------------------------------------
multi_path <- file.path(subsets_root, gv, paste0("hotspot_multi_stats_", gv, ".csv"))
if (file.exists(multi_path)) {
  multi_df <- read_csv(multi_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    filter(group == grp)
} else {
  multi_path2 <- file.path(data_dir(), "processed", "tables", "hotspot_multiservice_stats.csv")
  multi_df <- if (file.exists(multi_path2)) {
    read_csv(multi_path2, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
      filter(grouping == gv, group == grp)
  } else tibble()
}

# --- hotspot index (for GPKG paths) ------------------------------------------
index_path <- file.path(data_dir(), "processed", "hotspots", "_hotspots_index.csv")
hot_index  <- if (file.exists(index_path)) {
  read_csv(index_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    filter(group_col == gv, group_val == grp)
} else tibble()

# --- population exposure (income_grp only) ------------------------------------
pop_df <- tibble()
if (gv == "income_grp") {
  pop_path <- file.path(data_dir(), "processed", "tables", "hotspot_pop_exposure.csv")
  if (file.exists(pop_path)) {
    pop_df <- read_csv(pop_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
      filter(income_grp == grp)
  }
}

# --- driver overlap (global only) --------------------------------------------
driver_path <- file.path(data_dir(), "processed", "tables", "lcc_es_hotspot_overlap_pct.csv")
driver_df <- if (file.exists(driver_path)) {
  read_csv(driver_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else tibble()
```

## Hotspot Overview

```{r}
#| label: overview-table
#| echo: false

if (nrow(area_df) > 0) {
  area_df |>
    group_by(service) |>
    summarise(
      n_hot             = sum(n_hot),
      n_total           = first(n_total),
      pct_area          = first(pct_area),
      relative_intensity = mean(relative_intensity),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(relative_intensity)) |>
    mutate(
      pct_area           = round(pct_area, 2),
      relative_intensity = round(relative_intensity, 3)
    ) |>
    rename(
      Service             = service,
      `Hotspot cells`     = n_hot,
      `Total cells`       = n_total,
      `% Area`            = pct_area,
      `Relative Intensity` = relative_intensity
    ) |>
    knitr::kable(align = "lrrrr")
}
```

*Relative intensity > 1 means this group hosts a disproportionate share of global hotspots for that service.*

## Service Intensity

```{r}
#| label: intensity-plot
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

if (nrow(area_df) > 0) {
  svc_order <- c(
    "C_Risk", "N_export", "Sed_export",
    "C_Risk_Red_Ratio", "N_Ret_Ratio", "Sed_Ret_Ratio",
    "Pollination", "Nature_Access"
  )

  area_df |>
    mutate(service = factor(service, levels = svc_order)) |>
    filter(!is.na(service)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = relative_intensity, y = reorder(service, relative_intensity),
               fill = relative_intensity > 1)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E83737", "FALSE" = "gray70"), guide = "none") +
    labs(
      x     = "Relative Intensity (share of hotspots / share of area)",
      y     = NULL,
      title = paste0(grp, " — Hotspot Concentration by Service"),
      subtitle = "Red bars = disproportionately high burden; dashed line = global parity"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 12)
    )
}
```

## Multi-Service Overlap

```{r}
#| label: multi-plot
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

if (nrow(multi_df) > 0 && "mean_hotspots" %in% names(multi_df)) {
  multi_df |>
    ggplot(aes(x = mean_hotspots, y = reorder(group, mean_hotspots), fill = mean_hotspots)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      x     = "Mean overlapping hotspot services per cell",
      y     = NULL,
      title = "Compound Risk: Average Service Overlap"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
} else {
  cat("*Multi-service overlap data not available for this subgroup.*\n")
}
```

## Population Exposure

```{r}
#| label: pop-exposure
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5

if (nrow(pop_df) > 0) {
  svc_labels <- c(
    C_Risk            = "Coastal Risk",
    N_export          = "Nitrogen Export",
    Sed_export        = "Sediment Export",
    C_Risk_Red_Ratio  = "Coastal Risk Red. Ratio",
    N_Ret_Ratio       = "N Retention Ratio",
    Sed_Ret_Ratio     = "Sed Retention Ratio",
    Pollination       = "Pollination",
    Nature_Access     = "Nature Access"
  )

  pop_df |>
    group_by(service) |>
    summarise(exposed_population = sum(exposed_population, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(service_label = recode(service, !!!svc_labels)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(service_label, exposed_population), y = exposed_population,
               fill = exposed_population)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M")) +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Reds", direction = 1, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      x     = NULL,
      y     = "Exposed population",
      title = paste0(grp, " — Population Exposed in Hotspots")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
} else {
  cat(paste0(
    "*Population exposure by income group is only pre-computed for the `income_grp` ",
    "grouping variable. For other groupings, re-run `hotspot_synthesis.qmd` with the ",
    "raw grid to generate cross-tabulated exposure.*\n"
  ))
}
```

## Land Cover Driver Attribution

```{r}
#| label: driver-plot
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5

if (nrow(driver_df) > 0) {
  svc_labels <- c(
    C_Risk            = "Coastal Risk",
    N_export          = "Nitrogen Export",
    Sed_export        = "Sediment Export",
    C_Risk_Red_Ratio  = "Coastal Risk Red. Ratio",
    N_Ret_Ratio       = "N Retention Ratio",
    Sed_Ret_Ratio     = "Sed Retention Ratio",
    Pollination       = "Pollination",
    Nature_Access     = "Nature Access"
  )

  driver_df |>
    mutate(service_label = recode(service, !!!svc_labels)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(driver, pct_overlap), y = pct_overlap, fill = pct_overlap)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~service_label, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      x     = NULL,
      y     = "% of hotspot cells overlapping with driver",
      title = "Land Cover Change Attribution (global)",
      subtitle = "Note: driver attribution is global; subregional breakdown requires raw grid data"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}
```

## Hotspot Index

```{r}
#| label: gpkg-table
#| echo: false

if (nrow(hot_index) > 0) {
  hot_index |>
    select(metric, n_hot, n_total, pct_hot) |>
    mutate(
      pct_hot = round(pct_hot, 3),
      n_hot   = format(n_hot, big.mark = ","),
      n_total = format(n_total, big.mark = ",")
    ) |>
    rename(
      Metric       = metric,
      `Hotspot cells` = n_hot,
      `Total cells`   = n_total,
      `% Hotspot`     = pct_hot
    ) |>
    knitr::kable()
} else {
  cat("*No hotspot index entries found for this group.*\n")
}
```
